title: System Administrator
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and skilled IT Support Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing technical support and ensuring the smooth operation of our IT systems. This includes troubleshooting hardware and software issues, configuring and maintaining network devices, and supporting end\-users with their technical needs

**Key Responsibilities:**

Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network issues.

Install, configure, and maintain operating systems, software applications, and hardware.

Perform regular system updates and backups.

Monitor system performance and ensure optimal functioning.

Configure and maintain network devices such as routers, switches, and firewalls.

Ensure network security through proper configuration of VPNs, firewalls, and antivirus software.

Troubleshoot network connectivity issues.

Assist users with setting up new accounts and systems.

Document and maintain accurate records of user issues and resolutions

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have any expereince with hardware software trouble shooting

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* total work: 1 year (Required)
* Microsoft Windows Server: 1 year (Required)
* Linux: 1 year (Required)
* Mac: 1 year (Required)

Location:

* Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support Executive
description:
**Job Description:**

**Job Title:** Technical Support Executive  
**Company:** Elightwalk Technology  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** Fresher to 6 months

**Job Description:**  
Elightwalk Technology is hiring a dedicated and customer\-focused Technical Support Executive. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in troubleshooting technical issues and providing excellent client support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide technical support via calls, emails, and chat
* Troubleshoot software, hardware, and network\-related issues
* Install, configure, and maintain systems and applications
* Manage and update support tickets and documentation
* Coordinate with the development team to resolve complex issues

**Required Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of IT systems, networking, and troubleshooting
* Familiarity with Windows, Linux, or macOS
* Understanding of web applications, hosting, and domains (preferred)
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure

**Preferred Skills:**

* Knowledge of web hosting, DNS, domains, and cPanel
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and PHP
* Experience with support tools like Zendesk or Freshdesk

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field

**How to Apply:**  
Interested candidates can share their CV on this number **7600897405** or apply directly on Indeed.

Work Location: In person

Pay: ₹14,000\.00 \- ₹16,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
